verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community benchmark. It shows Ollama running Qwen3.5 variants in q4_K_M, nvfp4, and int4 quantizations via 'ollama run', so some INT4-class and FP4 quantized models load in practice. No first-party documentation describes supported quantization formats. Missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization formats, evidence of FP8 loading, evidence of GPTQ and AWQ support, evidence of loading arbitrary externally quantized checkpoints.
